original_ask: Pick the queue technology for the billing pipeline.
intent_brief: Choose a queue for billing events: reliable, cheap to run, easy to operate.

loops.eli5: Seven experts suggested queues; we kept the five most reliable and cheap.

candidates.body: Managed queue with dead-letter topic and idempotent consumers.
candidates.eli5: A post office that never loses letters.

retro: Lesson proposed: always include idempotency in billing designs.
